title: Frontend: New + Edit course pages + list enhancements
content:
Wire CourseForm into actual pages and add edit/delete/toggle to the courses list.

## 1. Rewrite new/page.tsx
Replace the placeholder with a page that renders CourseForm in 'create' mode. On success, redirect to /[locale]/admin/courses with success toast.

## 2. Create [id]/edit/page.tsx
New page that fetches course by ID (GET /api/admin/courses/[id]), passes initialData to CourseForm in 'edit' mode. Handle loading skeleton while fetching, error state if course not found. On success, redirect to /[locale]/admin/courses with success toast.

## 3. Enhance courses/page.tsx (list)
Add to each table row:
- Edit button (pencil icon) → link to /[locale]/admin/courses/[id]/edit
- Delete button (trash icon) → confirmation dialog → DELETE /api/admin/courses/[id]
- Inline registration status toggle (click badge to cycle OPEN/CLOSED) → PATCH with { registrationStatus }

Delete confirmation dialog:
- Title: dict.confirmDelete
- Body: dict.deleteWarning (shows course name, warns if has registrants)
- Confirm button: dict.delete (destructive variant)
- Cancel button: dict.cancel
- On confirm: call DELETE API, remove row from list, show toast on success/error
acceptance: New Course page renders CourseForm in create mode, redirects on success
Edit Course page fetches course and renders CourseForm in edit mode
Courses list has Edit/Delete buttons per row
Delete confirmation dialog appears and calls DELETE API
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: src/app/[locale]/admin/courses/page.tsx (refactor — add action buttons, status toggle, delete dialog)
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && manual E2E: create → edit → toggle → delete
